name: CleanCatalog Quote for WooCommerce
author: ozkanworks

sections.description:
Turn your WooCommerce store into a clean B2B catalog or Request a Quote storefront in minutes—without slowing down your site, breaking your theme, or disabling page caching.

Whether you sell wholesale, custom-built equipment, made-to-order products, or showroom inventory, CleanCatalog Quote for WooCommerce lets customers browse your catalog, pick variations, build a multi-item quote list, and send inquiries straight into WooCommerce → Orders.

What You Can Do

  • 4 Storefront Modes: Switch cleanly between Normal Store, Catalog Only (disable purchasing and link to a custom Contact / Enquiry button), Catalog + Request a Quote (replace Add to Cart with Add to Quote), or Quote Alongside Cart (keep regular checkout active alongside a quote option).
  • Hide Product Prices: Hide storefront prices globally and optionally show custom replacement text such as “Contact for Pricing”—while keeping prices visible to your team in WP Admin.
  • Multi-Item Quote List (Popup Modal or Dedicated Page): Visitors can add multiple products and quantities to a Quote List and submit everything via a slide-up popup modal or a dedicated page using the Quote Request Basket block or [ccatq_quote_basket] shortcode.
  • Full Variable Product Support: Customers can choose exact product variations (size, color, material—including “Any” attribute combinations) before adding items to their quote.
  • Quotes Managed Like Real WooCommerce Orders: Every inquiry is stored cleanly inside WooCommerce → Orders under the editable Quote Request status (wc-ccatq-quote) with automatic confirmation emails sent to both the store admin and the customer.

Ideal For

  • Wholesale, B2B, and trade stores needing custom pricing or bulk inquiries
  • Custom-manufactured, configured, or made-to-order products
  • Showrooms and manufacturer catalogs displaying stock without direct online checkout
  • Stores temporarily pausing checkout while keeping product pages visible

Built for Modern WooCommerce (For Agencies & Developers)

Unlike legacy catalog plugins that drop session cookies on every visitor or break modern WooCommerce templates, CleanCatalog is engineered for current WordPress and WooCommerce standards:

  • Full Site Editing (FSE) & Classic Themes: Natively supports WooCommerce blocks (woocommerce/add-to-cart-form, woocommerce/add-to-cart-with-options, woocommerce/product-button, woocommerce/mini-cart, woocommerce/product-price) as well as classic themes like Astra, Kadence, and Storefront.
  • Zero Page-Cache Destruction: Never calls session_start() or wp_rand() on page loads and never sets PHPSESSID or wp_woocommerce_session_ cookies on anonymous shoppers. Guest quote lists stay in browser localStorage until submission.
  • Cache-Safe REST Submission: Fetches a fresh nonce via a nocache_headers() endpoint only when submitting a quote, backed by honeypot, same-origin checks, and server-side IP transient rate limiting.
  • HPOS Native Orders: Uses official WooCommerce CRUD (wc_create_order()), declares HPOS and Cart/Checkout Block compatibility, and excludes unpaid quote requests from revenue analytics.
  • SEO-Safe by Default: Never fakes out-of-stock status via is_in_stock() (avoiding false “Out of Stock” warnings in search results). Optional opt-in toggles allow removing JSON-LD offers or masking Store API (/wc/store/v1/products) prices when prices are hidden.

Optional Pro Extension

Looking for granular B2B rules and quote-to-payment checkout? Clean Catalog & Quote Pro extends the free plugin with:

  • Targeted Rules Matrix: Apply different modes or price visibility rules by WordPress user role, logged-out guests, logged-in users, product categories, tags, or per-product overrides.
  • Extra B2B Quote Form Fields: Capture Tax / VAT / EORI ID, shipping country/city, target delivery date, PO reference, and up to 2 custom fields.
  • Branded Printable Quote Proposals: Generate clean Print / Save-as-PDF proposal sheets (noindex, nofollow) with your logo, address, terms, and expiry date.
  • Quote-to-Payment Workflow: Email customers a Quote Sent proposal link that opens WooCommerce’s native Pay for Order screen—with automatic daily quote expiration.

External Services

The free version of CleanCatalog Quote for WooCommerce operates completely on your own WordPress server and does not connect to any external third-party APIs or services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cleancatalog-quote-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the Plugins → Add New screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu (requires WooCommerce 9.0+).
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Catalog & Quote to pick your Storefront Mode and customize button labels or price text.
  4. Optionally place the Quote Request Basket block or [ccatq_quote_basket] shortcode on a dedicated quote page.
sections.faq:
Will this slow down my site or break Cloudflare / WP Rocket / LiteSpeed caching?

No. Pending quote lists stay in the visitor’s browser localStorage, and no PHP sessions or WooCommerce session cookies are created when anonymous visitors browse your shop. A fresh REST nonce is fetched via a no-store endpoint (GET /wp-json/ccatq/v1/nonce) only at the moment a shopper clicks Submit.

Does hiding prices mark my products as “Out of Stock” in Google?

No. CleanCatalog never modifies is_in_stock(), preventing false “Out of Stock” Google Search issues. An optional opt-in setting also lets you strip JSON-LD offers or mask /wc/store/v1/products prices when Hide Price is active.

Does it work with Block Themes (FSE) and WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. It supports Full Site Editing WooCommerce blocks (including the Mini-Cart, Product Price, Product Button, Add to Cart Form, and Add to Cart with Options blocks), classic themes, and WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Where do submitted quote requests appear?

Every submitted quote creates an editable order under WooCommerce → Orders with the Quote Request status (wc-ccatq-quote) and sends email notifications to both the store admin and the customer.
